changes.text: 华莱士在特尔纳特写成一篇论文，寄给达尔文；莱尔和胡克认为，它与达尔文多年未发表的手稿讲的是同一套理论。两人决定把双方的材料同场宣读，并把理由写成一封信。

Wallace sends Darwin a paper written at Ternate; Lyell and Hooker judge that it sets out the same theory as a manuscript Darwin has left unpublished for years. They arrange for both men's material to be read together, and set down their reasons in a letter.
各自独立得出同一理论的两个人
Two Men Who Reached the Same Theory Independently
1858年6月30日，伦敦。两位皇家学会会员莱尔与胡克联名给林奈学会秘书贝内特写信，随信附上几份材料；信里说，这些材料都关于同一个主题。麻烦在于：同一套理论被两个人各自独立想了出来，而两个人都没把它发表出去。信里说，二人都可以公平地要求享有作为这一重要研究方向上原创思想者的功绩。

London, 30 June 1858. Charles Lyell and J. D. Hooker, both Fellows of the Royal Society, wrote a joint letter to J. J. Bennett, secretary of the Linnean Society, enclosing papers which, they said, "all relate to the same subject". The difficulty was: the same theory had occurred to two men working independently of each other, and neither had published. The two men, the letter says, "may both fairly claim the merit of being original thinkers in this important line of inquiry."

先把两位当事人摆出来。达尔文这边，有一份关于物种的手稿：1839年草拟，1844年誊写，胡克在1844年读过誊本，内容后来又告诉了莱尔。多年里，莱尔和胡克反复催达尔文把观点发表出来，他一直没有。华莱士这边，1854年出发去东印度，在马来群岛一带考察了近八年，研究这些岛屿和部分巴布亚的动植物；更早的1848年，他与贝茨同赴巴西，走亚马逊和内格罗河的原始森林，1852年返英，他那批尤以鸟类和植物见长的收藏，大半毁于海难。1877年的一篇人物小传记下关键的一句：他在马来群岛研究时并不知道达尔文在同一方向上的先前工作，却得出了几乎相同的结论。

Begin with the two men themselves. Darwin had a manuscript on species: drafted in 1839, copied out in 1844. Hooker read that copy in 1844, and its contents later reached Lyell. For years the two of them pressed Darwin to publish his views; for years he held back. Wallace, meanwhile, was travelling. He set out for the East Indies in 1854 and spent nearly eight years exploring the islands of the Malay Archipelago and parts of Papua, studying their animals and plants. Earlier, in 1848, he had gone to Brazil with Bates, through the primeval forests of the Amazon and the Rio Negro, and returned to England in 1852; his collections, especially rich in birds and plants, were largely destroyed by shipwreck. A sketch published in 1877 supplies the decisive sentence: while pursuing his researches in the Malay Archipelago, Wallace was unaware of Darwin's earlier labours in the same direction, yet arrived at almost the same general conclusions.
作者认为，问题不是谁对，而是两个人各自独立做出同一件事时，功劳怎么分、由谁来分。一种解释是，这件事必须落到纸面上：谁署名、谁先讲、由哪个机构讲、按什么顺序讲。莱尔和胡克选择由自己出面安排，并把理由写进一封公开发表的信里。

In the author's view, the question was never who was right. It was what to do when two people have independently done the same thing: how credit gets divided, and who divides it. On one reading, it had to be settled on paper - whose name went on the work, who spoke first, through which institution, and in what order. Lyell and Hooker chose to arrange the matter themselves, and to write their reasoning into a letter that was published.
达尔文的那份旧手稿从未打算发表。1858年，达尔文为它加了一条脚注，署“C. D. 1858”，说明这份手稿从未打算发表，因此写得并不仔细。
Darwin's old manuscript was never intended for publication. In 1858 he added a footnote to it: "This MS. work was never intended for publication, and therefore was not written with care.—C. D. 1858."
第二份材料是达尔文1857年10月写给美国波士顿的阿萨·格雷教授的一封私人信的摘要；按莱尔和胡克的信所说，信中重申了他的看法，并表明这些看法从1839年到1857年没有改变。

The second item was an abstract of a private letter Darwin had written in October 1857 to Professor Asa Gray, of Boston, U.S., in which, according to Lyell and Hooker's letter, he repeated his views, and which showed that they had remained unaltered from 1839 to 1857.

第三份材料是华莱士的论文，标题《论变种无限偏离原初类型的倾向》，落款特尔纳特，1858年2月。它是写给朋友兼通信者达尔文看的，作者表示：如果达尔文认为它足够新颖、有意思，就请转给莱尔。两份材料的开头读来很不一样。达尔文的摘录从德堪多讲起：德堪多曾雄辩地宣称，整个自然都处在战争之中，生物与生物相争，或与外部自然相争；随后又说，这就是马尔萨斯的学说，而且多数情形下作用强了十倍。华莱士则从一条反对意见讲起：家养变种不稳定，任其自然便常常回到亲本的样子，有人以此认为物种是分别创造、永远不变的。出发点不同，落点接近。

The third item was Wallace's essay, "On the Tendency of Varieties to depart indefinitely from the Original Type," dated Ternate, February 1858. It was written for his friend and correspondent Darwin to read, with the express wish that, "if Mr. Darwin thought it sufficiently novel and interesting," it should be forwarded to Lyell. The two openings read very differently. Darwin's extract opens from De Candolle: "De Candolle, in an eloquent passage, has declared that all nature is at war, one organism with another, or with external nature." A few sentences later it calls the struggle "the doctrine of Malthus applied in most cases with tenfold force." Wallace opens from an objection - that domestic varieties are unstable and tend to revert to the parent form, which is taken to show that species were created distinct and are kept that way. Different starting points, converging destinations.
莱尔和胡克向达尔文说明了这样做的理由，达尔文同意由他们自行处置他的手稿。他们写下的理由不止是替两人分先后：他们说，这样做不只是考虑他与他的朋友谁更有优先权，而是为了科学的整体利益。他们认为，建立在大量事实之上、经多年思考而成熟的观点，应当立刻成为别人可以出发的目标；又补了一句实在话：在科学界等待达尔文完整著作问世期间，先把他的一些主要研究结果，连同那位能干的通信者的结果，一起摆到公众面前。

Lyell and Hooker put their reasoning to Darwin, and he gave them permission to make what use they thought proper of his memoir. Their grounds went beyond ranking two men: "we are not solely considering the relative claims to priority of himself and his friend, but the interests of science generally". They held that views founded on a wide deduction from facts, and matured by years of reflection, should "constitute at once a goal from which others may start". Then a plain practical point: while the scientific world was waiting for Darwin's complete work, some of the leading results of his labours, together with those of his able correspondent, should be laid before the public.
1858年7月1日，林奈学会宣读了这批材料。信中依次列出三份材料，各附日期：1839年草拟、1844年誊写的手稿摘录，1857年致格雷信的摘要，华莱士1858年2月的论文；当天按什么顺序宣读，材料没有记。十九年后那篇小传的记述是：华莱士的论文经莱尔转交林奈学会，1858年7月1日宣读，与达尔文的论文同场；小传给出的标题是《论物种形成变种的倾向，以及物种与变种借自然选择得以延续》。

On 1 July 1858 the material was read to the Linnean Society. The letter lists the three items in turn, each with its date: extracts from the manuscript drafted in 1839 and copied in 1844, the abstract of the 1857 letter to Gray, and Wallace's essay of February 1858; the order in which they were read that day is not recorded. Nineteen years later the sketch of Wallace recorded that his essay, transmitted through Sir Charles Lyell to the Linnean Society, "was read before that body on July 1, 1858, coincidently with the reading of Mr, Darwin's paper" - the sketch gives the title as "On the Tendency of Species to form Varieties, and on the Perpetuation of Species and Varieties by means of Natural Selection".
小传还顺笔记下华莱士后来的路：1862年回英国，此后多年整理他庞大的收藏——100,000余件昆虫标本、8,000多只鸟；1868年获皇家学会奖章，1870年获巴黎地理学会金质奖章，同年出版《自然选择理论文集》。在人类起源问题上，他承认自然选择对达尔文归于它的多数变化有效，但否认单靠自然选择、没有某种更高原因的共同作用，就能完成从类人猿到人的过渡。

The sketch also follows Wallace's later course. He returned to England in 1862 and spent several years classifying an enormous collection - upward of 100,000 insect specimens and more than 8,000 birds. In 1868 the Royal Society gave him its royal medal; in 1870 the Geographical Society of Paris its gold medal, and in that same year he published "Contributions to the Theory of Natural Selection". On human origins, though he recognized the efficacy of natural selection in producing most of the changes Darwin attributed to it, he denied that it was competent, without the joint agency of some higher cause, to effect the transition from the anthropoid apes to man.

作者把他们的做法概括为：算，但要公开兑现。作者列出的替代做法至少有三种，各有代价：由达尔文先单独发表；只发华莱士，把达尔文的优先权留给他日后自述；或者都等达尔文的完整著作出来再说。其中第二种与信中所记达尔文的倾向相对应：他提议尽快发表华莱士的论文，并强烈倾向于扣下自己的手稿；其余两种是作者提出的对照选项，不是材料里的记载。实际被选中的是第四条：三份材料同场宣读，日期写进正文，理由写给一位秘书并公开发表。莱尔和胡克自己说，这样做的依据是让经年思考、建立在大量事实上的观点立刻成为别人可以出发的目标。分配交给了程序，当事人的让步只是其中一步。

The author's summary of their course is: yes, but it has to be cashed in publicly. The author sets out at least three alternative courses, each with its own price: Darwin publishing alone first; only Wallace published, with Darwin left to state his own priority later; or everyone waiting for Darwin's complete book. The second corresponds to the inclination the letter records in Darwin: he proposed that Wallace's essay be published as soon as possible, and was strongly inclined to withhold his own memoir; the other two are options constructed by the author for contrast, not episodes recorded in the documents. The course actually taken was a fourth: three sets of material read together in one session, the dates printed in the body of the text, the reasoning addressed to a secretary and made public. The warrant Lyell and Hooker gave was that views founded on a wide deduction from facts and matured by years of reflection should at once become a goal from which others might start. The allocation was handed to a procedure; a party's willingness to give way was one step in it.
本文依据的记录有三类，都要打折看。一类是莱尔和胡克1858年6月30日给林奈学会秘书的说明信，他们是安排的当事人，也是作证人；一类是1858年林奈学会会刊所载的论文正文、标题与脚注；还有一类是1877年《大众科学月刊》上的一篇人物小传，刊出时距1858年已十九年。手头没有达尔文、华莱士完整的私人通信，所以本文不写他们的心情，不写他们当场的反应，也不写两人私下如何商量。

The records this article rests on fall into three classes, and each deserves a discount. One is the explanatory letter Lyell and Hooker wrote to the secretary of the Linnean Society on 30 June 1858; they were at once parties to the arrangement and witnesses to it. Another is the papers themselves as printed in the Linnean Society's journal in 1858 - their text, headings and footnote. The third is a personal sketch in Popular Science Monthly from 1877, published nineteen years after the event. With no full private correspondence of Darwin's or Wallace's in hand, this article does not write about their feelings, their reactions at the time, or how the two of them settled matters between themselves.

本文依据的记录有三：莱尔与胡克1858年6月30日致林奈学会秘书的说明信（两人均为安排当事人）、1858年林奈学会会刊所载的论文正文、标题与脚注，以及1877年一篇杂志人物小传。没有达尔文、华莱士完整的私人通信，故不写其心情与反应；华莱士在宣读前是否知情或同意，材料未载，本文不作陈述；致格雷信日期两说并存（1857年10月／1857年9月5日），不作裁决；宣读当天的具体经过与达尔文完整著作的出版不在范围内。

This article rests on three records: Lyell and Hooker's explanatory letter of 30 June 1858 to the secretary of the Linnean Society (both were parties to the arrangement), the papers themselves as printed in the Linnean Society's journal in 1858 (their text, headings and footnote), and a magazine personal sketch of 1877. No full private correspondence of Darwin's or Wallace's is in hand, so their feelings and reactions are not described; whether Wallace knew of or consented to the reading beforehand is not recorded in the material and no statement is made; the date of the letter to Gray stands in two versions (October 1857 / 5 September 1857) and is not adjudicated; how the reading went on the day and the later publication of Darwin's complete work fall outside the scope.

dispositions.rationale: 证据只记论文写于特尔纳特，并寄给达尔文，没有寄出地点，也没有说特尔纳特属于马来群岛。中文改为“华莱士在特尔纳特写成一篇论文，寄给达尔文”，英文同步改。

evidence.quote: This was written at Ternate in February 1858

dispositions.rationale: 两人是朋友和通信者，“互不通气”与证据冲突。标题改为“各自独立得出同一理论的两个人”，英文同步改。

evidence.quote: for the perusal of his friend and correspondent Mr. Darwin
independently and unknown to one another

dispositions.rationale: 英文删去证据中没有的中间名 Dalton，改为 J. D. Hooker。

evidence.quote: J. D. Hooker
Jos. D. Hooker

dispositions.rationale: 中文去掉引号，明确写成转述，并补回“功绩”(merit)；英文保留逐字引语。

evidence.quote: may both fairly claim the merit of being original thinkers in this important line of inquiry

dispositions.rationale: 英文删去“brought home”，只说收藏大半毁于海难，与证据和中文一致。中文原文无此问题，未作改动。

evidence.quote: were in great part destroyed by shipwreck

dispositions.rationale: 首句加上“作者认为”和“In the author's view”，标明这是作者判断。
英文改为“a letter that was published”，只陈述发表这一结果，去掉写信时的意图，与中文一致。
删去“有点尴尬”和“awkward”这类评价，只保留证据所载事实。英文顺带删去引语后多余的句点。

evidence.quote: This MS. work was never intended for publication

dispositions.rationale: 删去“为了显示”这一选材动机。改为直接陈述第二份材料是什么，并注明“它表明看法未变”是莱尔和胡克信中的说法。

evidence.quote: which shows that these remained unaltered from 1839 to 1857

dispositions.rationale: 中文改为“两份材料的开头读来很不一样”，英文改为“The two openings”，只指证据中给出开头的两份材料。
德堪多一句与马尔萨斯一句之间还隔着两句。中文改为“随后又说”，英文改为“A few sentences later”。

evidence.quote: The war, however, is not constant
It is the doctrine of Malthus applied in most cases with tenfold force.

dispositions.rationale: 把两个分句分开写：“可以出发的目标”仍归于经年思考、建立在大量事实之上的观点；“在科学界等待期间把两人结果一并公之于众”另成一句。删去“与其空等，不如”这一比较，并把“多年劳作”收窄为“his labours/研究结果”。

evidence.quote: views founded on a wide deduction from facts, and matured by years of reflection, should constitute at once a goal from which others may start
while the scientific world is waiting for the appearance of Mr. Darwin's complete work

dispositions.rationale: 改为“信中依次列出三份材料，各附日期”，不再断言信是按日期排列的。英文同步改。

evidence.quote: 1. Extracts from a MS. work on Species

dispositions.rationale: 从 record 段中删去含“共同发现者”的作者看法句。该说法不见于证据，又属解释，删去后本段只保留小传记载。

evidence.quote: may both fairly claim the merit of being original thinkers

dispositions.rationale: 改为“他承认自然选择对达尔文归于它的多数变化有效，但否认单靠它、没有更高原因的共同作用就能完成从类人猿到人的过渡”。删去“不接受达尔文的结论”和“would not follow Darwin”。本段英文数字100,000与8,000在中文中也同步写出。

evidence.quote: Though recognizing the efficacy of natural selection in producing most of the changes attributed to its action by Mr. Darwin

dispositions.rationale: 注明第二种替代做法与信中所记达尔文的提议和倾向相对应，其余两种才是作者提出的对照选项。ev 补入 V-E6。

evidence.quote: provided Mr. Darwin did not withhold from the public, as he was strongly inclined to do (in favour of Mr. Wallace), the memoir

dispositions.rationale: 删去英文末尾的“not the deciding one”，使中英两版的判断强度一致。
改为以刊出时间计算：中文“刊出时距1858年已十九年”，英文“published nineteen years after the event”，与正文“十九年后”的口径统一。

evidence.quote: was read before that body on July 1, 1858

dispositions.rationale: 记录由两类改为三类，补上1858年林奈学会会刊所载的论文正文、标题与脚注。ev 补入 V-E11 和 V-E12。

evidence.quote: dated Down, September 5th , 1857
This MS. work was never intended for publication

dispositions.rationale: 不确定性说明中补上第三份依据，即1858年林奈学会会刊所载的论文正文、标题与脚注。中英同步。

evidence.quote: dated Down, September 5th , 1857
